additional_info.subject: ID0454565-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP / T6 170004836] Charging issue CRM:03044000021
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes,
We have checked the logs and found something peculiar. It seems like the customer attempted to charge the EV 6 times and only the last session it worked accordingly.
Please be aware that the zero sessions are all sessions failed before even authentication, so there were no losses for the customer.
Here are the logs from the provider timestamps and analysis:
First session:
As you can see in this last log, the SLAC communication was not established, you can see this based on the missing EVCCID and EVMAC. To confirm this, we see right after these 2 variables. "no PLC link", which shows that there is Power Line communication between the EV and the EVSE.
This happens for the next 4 sessions and at the last session it finally worked.
We also checked the sessions from the last 7 days and based on 32 sessions there was no similar behavior. Even though there were 5 failed sessions they all failed in authentication.
Please let me know if this answers your question.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best Regards,
Marcelo

additional_info.subject: ID0454565-DC/Si-D/AT-[RVP / T6 170004836] Charging issue CRM:03044000021
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
As we already discussed, the "no PLC link" means that the EV failed to transmit a part of chain process of the SLAC communication between EVSE and EV.
From our side, the only thing we can do is tell you in which part it fails as it's nothing easily troubleshoot and usually these cases revolve around having a Vehicle integration.
I checked from the past days and there was no failed session except one where the process was wrongly started:
The 0-session you see there it was the customer that plugged in the EV and before the authentication could start, he plugged out resulting in error.
From my side, we can only understand if the problem comes from that specific EV or not and find where it's failing, to send to the OEM.
The only other possibility is (
entirely up to you but there is no recommendation from my side as there is absolutely no proof that this is the problem
) to replace the EcoG and last resort the CCS.
During SLAC there is only 3 active components:
- EcoG
- CCS
- EV
Let me know what you want to do with this ticket, if this answered your needs or if you want to schedule some sessions and prove where it fails.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
